decision: Keep the current Q smooth and wave fields; prescribe their own physical-normal derivative. Add an analytic simple zero-Neumann control; retire the geometry-corrected oblique zero-N field from primary qualification without relabelling historical results.
simple_zero_N: 1+(1-u*u)^2*s; wall value 1, all first logical derivatives zero at u=1
normal_data: n dot physical grad(f) = (g^{u j}/sqrt(g^{uu}))*partial_j f, using full outward physical normal; no manufactured wall correction
wave_formula: exp(i*(2*pi*x_or_y/lambda+eta)); real and imaginary parts are cosine and sine controls
reference: unchanged continuum midpoint operator, followed by complete stored-volume owner projection
scope: Existing 36 singleton wall/switch targets and existing selected maps/traces. No new tracing, support selection, factorization, global qualification or P-path changes.
